title: UI风格#131 - Scandinavian Midsummer (斯堪的纳维亚仲夏)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Scandinavian Midsummer style When color palette Then features daisy white, meadow green, sunshine yellow, sky blue, berry red
Given Scandinavian Midsummer style When typography Then uses nordic fonts: Josefin Sans, Nunito, or Quicksand
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Josefin Sans (headers 2.2rem 300 weight), Nunito (body 0.95rem 400-600 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Scandinavian Midsummer style When layout Then flower meadows, maypole center, cottage windows, lake shores
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: sun ray gradient overlay, meadow-style layout with floral accents, light airy background gradients

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Scandinavian Midsummer style When UI elements Then daisy chains, sun rays, maypole dancing, butterfly flutter
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: sunshine yellow/sky blue/meadow green accents, sun symbol in border, floral icons (☘, ✿, ⚘), gentle hover animations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Scandinavian Midsummer UI When functional Then includes meadow chat, folk agents, nature stats
